text.description_html:
Fusion B-EL-B5, Ribbon and Reed Rose Doorbell Button

Constructed out of solid brass, this Fusion Hardware made doorbell is fashioned in the traditional French Colonial style. The Ribbon and Reed design is well known in as such and will be sure to add a bit of old world charm to your home. Available in oil rubbed bronze, brushed nickel, and antique pewter. Packaged as a kit with matching finish installation screws and a lighted button.

Please Note This is a replacement trim only. It comes packaged with lighted button, rosette, and installation screws. It DOES NOT include the chime.

Specifications for the French Colonial Round Ribbon and Reed Doorbell Fusion B-EL-B5:

  • Rose Diameter: 2-5/8"
  • Material: Solid Brass
  • Includes lighted button.
  • Packaged as a kit with matching finish installation screws and a lighted button.

Sold Individually
